text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One afternoon...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(How unbecoming of me to have left
something in
the classroom... I could
fetch it tomorrow, but I
think today
I'll—)
Mumble, mumble.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...Is someone speaking in the
classroom?)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure this is what you want?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure. Because... I've been left
behind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's why, sometime this year... I'm
thinking of
quitting racing...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Well, I just wanted to let you know
today, as soon
as I could... With that out
of the way, I should be
leaving.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O! Please! You must reconsider—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ngh?! Ardan?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry! I didn't mean to
eavesdrop, but
what you were saying
just now—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah! Chiyono O!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O, wait!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Why... Why would you ever consider
quitting
racing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Your legs are healing all the time, little
by little.
And you're even back at the
academy now! You'll
be able to run
again soon!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: So why would you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Would you... tell me the reason?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...There's no one else here. I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Right after the Derby, when I found out
I'd have
to be hospitalized...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I thought... I could recover and then
throw myself
back into racing again...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But time went on with me being unable
to train at
all, and as I watched the
Twinkle Series at home
or from my
hospital room...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I became more and more afraid...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I saw all the races that you and Yaeno
entered.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And I could tell... you were both getting
stronger
by the day...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I thought you two were amazing... and so
cool...
And every time I thought that...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help wondering, "Why am I
here right
now?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It felt like... you two were going
someplace far,
far away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Then it dawned on me... that this was my
future...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...And besides, even I know it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I know my running won't improve any
further... I
know I reached my limit a long
time ago...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So, there's probably no point in my
returning to
racing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And if there's no point...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Then I figured I might as well quit
racing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That was all I had to say. Okay, I'll be
going now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You and I may be kindred spirits after
all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
All that you shared with me just now...
All those
sentiments sounded similar to
ones I once held
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
After I enrolled in Tracen Academy,
there was a
period during which my
body kept me from
training as intensely
as I wanted to, even though I
was
race-ready.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As I watched everyone else make their
debuts, I
was haunted by a constant
anxiety—the fear that
I would simply
peter out...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm quite sure that... had I remained
alone, the
anxiety would have
overwhelmed me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You were there, by my side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You encouraged and supported me, and
had full
faith that I would debut
successfully. Thanks to
you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I was able to better myself, gain
confidence, and
eventually take on the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...But that's not all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
During the Japanese Derby, you raced
against me
as my rival without holding
anything back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It was through the clash we shared that
day that I
learned one can surpass one's
limits and improve
by competing with a
rival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O, you helped bring me to my
present
moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As such, it is now my turn to help take
you to
yours.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I always believed that you'd make your
return to
racing one day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even if you're struggling to have faith in
yourself,
I will keep believing in you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As... your rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But... But! I-I haven't been able to run at
all! Not
for such a long time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And in the time I spent out of action... I
lost all
my potential—I lost everything!
So there's no way
I could ever catch up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As long as you have rivals, Chiyono O,
those
limits you're thinking of can be
surpassed over
and over again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I know that you'll overcome your current limits, just as I once did. And you'll be able to compete against us again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'll never—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That race is approaching, and when it
does, I shall
be racing against Yaeno
once again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if you wouldn't mind... coming
along and
watching our battle in person?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I believe that words won't always suffice
and that
there are some things we can
only convey through
our running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I wish for you to feel it yourself, Chiyono
O,
through my running—the possibility
that you can
surpass your own limits.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shall wait for you, for however long it
takes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Mejiro Ardan's recount of
Sakura
Chiyono O's situation gives me a
glimpse into her
feelings...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I have the utmost faith in her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I believe that Chiyono O will make her
comeback
and reappear before us as a
rival to behold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having witnessed firsthand how strong
their bond
is, I can say that with
confidence.
choice_data_list: その確信はきっと正しいよ
choice_data_list_en: I'm sure that conviction of yours is right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!
choice_data_list_en: Let's give the Osaka Hai our all.
Let's do our best at the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The momentous Osaka Hai will soon be
upon us!
